title: Luoyang, Henan — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Luoyang, Henan: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Luoyang is a city in Henan with a population of 7,056,000. An ancient capital with over 1,500 years of history, famous for the Longmen Grottoes, White Horse Temple, and peony festivals. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
